```{r}
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
data_file <- "acute_yield_data_fall_2026.csv"
if (!file.exists(data_file)) {
  data_file <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wwy200311gy-sudo/stat628/refs/heads/main/acute_yield_data_fall_2026.csv"
}
d_raw <- read.csv(data_file)

d <- d_raw %>%
  mutate(
    year = factor(year),
    cultivar = factor(toupper(trimws(cultivar))),
    intensity_group = factor(toupper(trimws(intensity_group)),
                               levels = c("D", "C", "B", "A")),
    treatment = factor(toupper(trimws(treatment)),
                               levels = c("CONTROL", "OTC"),
                               labels = c("Control", "OTC")),
    heat_group = factor(
      ifelse(treatment == "Control", "Control", as.character(intensity_group)),
      levels = c("Control", "D", "C", "B", "A")
    ),
    pair = interaction(year, cultivar, intensity_group, plot,
                                    drop = TRUE),
    total_weight = healthy_weight + rotten_weight,
    healthy_count_pct = 100 * healthy_n / (healthy_n + rotten_n),
    healthy_weight_prop = healthy_weight / total_weight,
    healthy_weight_pct  = 100 * healthy_weight_prop,
    pulses = as.numeric(c(A = 4, B = 3, C = 2, D = 1)[
                                      as.character(intensity_group)])
  )

# Design checks
stopifnot(nrow(d) == 96, nlevels(d$pair) == 48)
stopifnot(!anyNA(d$heat_group))
stopifnot(all(d %>% count(pair) %>% pull(n) == 2))
stopifnot(all(d %>%
  group_by(pair) %>%
  summarise(ok = setequal(as.character(treatment), c("Control", "OTC")),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pull(ok)))
stopifnot(all(d$total_weight > 0), all(d$healthy_n + d$rotten_n > 0), all(d$healthy_weight > 0))
```


```{r}
summary(d$healthy_weight)
d %>% count(year, cultivar, heat_group)
```


```{r}
# Part 1: descriptive statistics

# 1a. Mean, SD and n of healthy weight in every cultivar x year x heat group
d %>%
  group_by(year, cultivar, heat_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean = mean(healthy_weight),
            sd   = sd(healthy_weight),
            min  = min(healthy_weight),
            max  = max(healthy_weight),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```


```{r}
# 1b. Raw data: every plot as one point, mean +/- SE in red
ggplot(d, aes(x = heat_group, y = healthy_weight)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.6, colour = "grey35") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, colour = "red", size = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(cultivar ~ year) +
  labs(x = "Heat group (Control, then D = 1 ... A = 4 pulses)",
       y = "Healthy fruit weight (g)",
       title = "Healthy fruit weight by heat group, cultivar and year",
       subtitle = "Grey = individual plots; red = mean +/- SE") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)
```


```{r}
# Part 2: within-pair log ratio OTC / Control
# Keep only the columns that are identical within a pair, plus the ones to spread.
# (Other columns such as rotten_n differ between the two rows and would prevent pivot_wider from merging the pair.)
pairs_wide <- d %>%
  select(pair, year, cultivar, intensity_group, pulses, treatment, healthy_weight) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = healthy_weight) %>%
  mutate(ratio = OTC / Control,
         log_ratio = log(ratio))

nrow(pairs_wide) 

# Summary: geometric mean ratio per cultivar-year-intensity
pairs_wide %>%
  group_by(year, cultivar, intensity_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_log_ratio = mean(log_ratio),
            geo_mean_ratio = exp(mean_log_ratio),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Plot: each point is one pair; 0 on the log scale = no change
ggplot(pairs_wide, aes(x = intensity_group, y = log_ratio)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.6, colour = "grey35") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, colour = "red", size = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(cultivar ~ year) +
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~ exp(.), name = "Ratio OTC / Control")) +
  labs(x = "Intensity group (D = 1 ... A = 4 pulses)",
       y = "log(OTC / Control) within pair",
       title = "Within-pair log ratio of healthy fruit weight",
       subtitle = "Below the dashed line = OTC lower than its own Control") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)
```


```{r}
# Part 3: log transform
grp <- d %>%
  group_by(year, cultivar, heat_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_raw = mean(healthy_weight),
            sd_raw   = sd(healthy_weight),
            mean_log = mean(log(healthy_weight)),
            sd_log   = sd(log(healthy_weight)),
            .groups = "drop")

# Put both scales in one long data frame (raw panel first, log panel second)
grp_long <- bind_rows(
  grp %>% transmute(scale = "Raw scale", year, cultivar, heat_group,
                    m = mean_raw, s = sd_raw),
  grp %>% transmute(scale = "Log scale", year, cultivar, heat_group,
                    m = mean_log, s = sd_log)
) %>%
  mutate(scale = factor(scale, levels = c("Raw scale", "Log scale")))

ggplot(grp_long, aes(x = m, y = s)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = cultivar,
                 colour = ifelse(heat_group == "Control", "Control", "OTC")),
             size = 2.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE,
              colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ scale, scales = "free") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Control = "grey20", OTC = "tomato")) +
  labs(x = "Group mean", y = "Group SD",
       title = "Group SD versus group mean on the raw and log scale",
       subtitle = "Each point is one cultivar x year x heat group (20 points)",
       shape = "Cultivar", colour = "Treatment") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

# Numerical version of the same question
grp %>%
  summarise(cor_raw = cor(mean_raw, sd_raw, method = "spearman"),
            cor_log = cor(mean_log, sd_log, method = "spearman"))
```


```{r}
# Part 4: Correlation between the two plots of a pair

# 4a. Overall correlation
cor(log(pairs_wide$Control), log(pairs_wide$OTC))

# 4b. Correlation within each cultivar x year
pairs_wide %>%
  group_by(year, cultivar) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            r_log = cor(log(Control), log(OTC)),

```


```{r}
# Part 5: interaction plots on the log scale
summ <- d %>%
  mutate(log_w = log(healthy_weight)) %>%
  group_by(year, cultivar, heat_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_log = mean(log_w),
            se = sd(log_w) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

# The y axis is on the log scale but labelled in grams
brks  <- c(250, 400, 600, 800, 1000)
scale_y_grams <- scale_y_continuous(breaks = log(brks), labels = brks)

# A: heat group x year, separately by cultivar
ggplot(summ, aes(x = heat_group, y = mean_log, colour = year, group = year)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_log - se, ymax = mean_log + se), width = 0.12) +
  facet_wrap(~ cultivar) +
  scale_y_grams +
  labs(x = "Heat group (Control, then D = 1 ... A = 4 pulses)",
       y = "Healthy weight (g), log scale",
       title = "Mean healthy weight by heat group and year, separately for each cultivar",
       colour = "Year") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

# B: heat group x cultivar, separately by year
ggplot(summ, aes(x = heat_group, y = mean_log, colour = cultivar, group = cultivar)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_log - se, ymax = mean_log + se), width = 0.12) +
  facet_wrap(~ year) +
  scale_y_grams +
  labs(x = "Heat group (Control, then D = 1 ... A = 4 pulses)",
       y = "Healthy weight (g), log scale",
       title = "Mean healthy weight by heat group and cultivar, separately for each year",
       colour = "Cultivar") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

# C: year x cultivar baseline, Control plots only
summ %>%
  filter(heat_group == "Control") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean_log, colour = cultivar, group = cultivar)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_log - se, ymax = mean_log + se), width = 0.08) +
  scale_y_grams +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Healthy weight (g), log scale",
       title = "Mean healthy weight of Control plots by year and cultivar",
       colour = "Cultivar") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)
```


```{r}
# Part 6: model comparison
fit_lmm <- function(form) lmer(form, data = d, REML = FALSE)

# no heat effect at all (baseline: cultivar x year only)
h_noheat <- fit_lmm(log(healthy_weight) ~ cultivar * year + (1 | pair))
# heat effect is the same in every cultivar-year
h0 <- fit_lmm(log(healthy_weight) ~ heat_group + cultivar + year + year:cultivar + (1 | pair))
# heat effect depends on cultivar
h1 <- fit_lmm(log(healthy_weight) ~ heat_group * cultivar + year + year:cultivar + (1 | pair))
# heat effect depends on year
h2 <- fit_lmm(log(healthy_weight) ~ heat_group * year + cultivar + year:cultivar + (1 | pair))
# heat effect depends on cultivar and on year, but no three-way interaction
h3 <- fit_lmm(log(healthy_weight) ~ heat_group * (cultivar + year) + year:cultivar + (1 | pair))
# full model: heat effect can differ in every cultivar-year
h_full <- fit_lmm(log(healthy_weight) ~ heat_group * cultivar * year + (1 | pair))

models <- list(h_noheat = h_noheat, h0 = h0, h1 = h1, h2 = h2, h3 = h3, h_full = h_full)
```


```{r}
# AIC / BIC table
aic_tab <- data.frame(
  model = names(models),
  df    = sapply(models, function(m) attr(logLik(m), "df")),
  AIC   = sapply(models, AIC),
  BIC   = sapply(models, BIC)
) %>%
  mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))
print(aic_tab, row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Likelihood-ratio tests between nested models
anova(h_noheat, h0)   # is there any heat effect?
anova(h0, h1)         # does the heat effect depend on cultivar?
anova(h0, h2)         # does the heat effect depend on year?
anova(h1, h3)         # adding heat x year after heat x cultivar
anova(h2, h3)         # adding heat x cultivar after heat x year
anova(h3, h_full)     # three-way interaction

sapply(models, isSingular)   # TRUE = pair variance estimated as ~0
```



```{r}
# Part 7: Equal-variance model and diagnostics
h2_lmm <- lmer(log(healthy_weight) ~ heat_group * year + cultivar + year:cultivar +
                   (1 | pair), data = d, REML = TRUE)
isSingular(h2_lmm)

# Residual diagnostics for the equal-variance model
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

# Residuals vs fitted values, coloured by treatment
plot(fitted(h2_lmm), resid(h2_lmm),
     col = ifelse(d$treatment == "OTC", "tomato", "grey30"), pch = 16,
     xlab = "Fitted value (log scale)", ylab = "Residual",
     main = "Residuals vs fitted")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
legend("topleft", legend = c("Control", "OTC"),
       col = c("grey30", "tomato"), pch = 16, bty = "n")

# Normal QQ plot of the residuals
qqnorm(resid(h2_lmm), main = "Normal QQ: residuals", pch = 16, col = "grey30")
qqline(resid(h2_lmm))

# Normal QQ plot of the estimated pair effects
re_pair <- ranef(h2_lmm)$pair[, 1]
qqnorm(re_pair, main = "Normal QQ: pair effects", pch = 16, col = "grey30")
qqline(re_pair)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# Residual SD by treatment
d %>%
  mutate(r = resid(h2_lmm)) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(sd_resid = sd(r)) 

```
```{r}
# Part 8: Model with separate residual variances for Control and OTC
library(nlme)

# Same fixed and random effects as h2_lmm, refitted with nlme
h2_hom <- lme(log(healthy_weight) ~ heat_group * year + cultivar + year:cultivar,
              random = ~ 1 | pair, data = d, method = "REML")

# Control and OTC plots have separate residual variances
h2_het <- update(h2_hom, weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | treatment))

# Likelihood-ratio test for unequal residual variances
anova(h2_hom, h2_het)

# Estimated residual SD of Control, and ratio OTC SD / Control SD
sigma(h2_het)
coef(h2_het$modelStruct$varStruct, unconstrained = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Diagnostics of the unequal-variance model, using Pearson residuals
r_pear <- resid(h2_het, type = "pearson")

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(fitted(h2_het), r_pear,
     col = ifelse(d$treatment == "OTC", "tomato", "grey30"), pch = 16,
     xlab = "Fitted value (log scale)", ylab = "Pearson residual",
     main = "Residuals vs fitted")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
legend("topleft", legend = c("Control", "OTC"),
       col = c("grey30", "tomato"), pch = 16, bty = "n")

qqnorm(r_pear, main = "Normal QQ: residuals", pch = 16, col = "grey30")
qqline(r_pear)

re_pair <- ranef(h2_het)[, 1]
qqnorm(re_pair, main = "Normal QQ: pair effects", pch = 16, col = "grey30")
qqline(re_pair)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# Pearson residual SD by treatment
d %>%
  mutate(r = r_pear) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(sd_resid = sd(r))
```
```{r}
# Part 9: Final model
h2_final <- h2_het
```


$$
\log Y_i = \mu + \alpha_{g_i} + \beta_{t_i} + (\alpha\beta)_{g_i t_i}
+ \gamma_{c_i} + (\beta\gamma)_{t_i c_i} + b_{k(i)} + \varepsilon_i,
$$
$$
b_k \sim N(0, \sigma_b^2), \qquad
\varepsilon_i \sim N\!\left(0, \sigma^2_{\text{trt}(i)}\right), \quad
\text{trt}(i) \in \{\text{Control}, \text{OTC}\},
$$
```{r}
# Coefficients of the final model
coef_tab <- summary(h2_final)$tTable
coef_ci  <- intervals(h2_final, which = "fixed")$fixed

data.frame(term     = rownames(coef_tab),
           estimate = coef_tab[, "Value"],
           SE       = coef_tab[, "Std.Error"],
           df       = coef_tab[, "DF"],
           p        = coef_tab[, "p-value"],
           ratio    = exp(coef_tab[, "Value"]),
           lower_95 = exp(coef_ci[, "lower"]),
           upper_95 = exp(coef_ci[, "upper"]),
           row.names = NULL) %>%
  kable(digits = 3)
```
```{r}
# Variance components of the final model
vc <- VarCorr(h2_final)
sd_pair <- as.numeric(vc["(Intercept)", "StdDev"])
sd_ctrl <- sigma(h2_final)
sd_otc  <- sd_ctrl * coef(h2_final$modelStruct$varStruct, unconstrained = FALSE)[1]

# Correlation between the Control and OTC plot of the same pair
icc <- sd_pair^2 / sqrt((sd_pair^2 + sd_ctrl^2) * (sd_pair^2 + sd_otc^2))

data.frame(component = c("pair SD", "residual SD (Control)", "residual SD (OTC)",
                         "within-pair correlation"),
           value = c(sd_pair, sd_ctrl, sd_otc, icc))
```


```{r}
# Part 10: Tests and contrasts
joint_tests(h2_final)

emm_h <- emmeans(h2_final, ~ heat_group | year)
```

```{r}
# Each intensity vs Control within each year, Dunnett-adjusted, as ratios OTC / Control
ct <- contrast(emm_h, "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "Control")
summary(ct, type = "response", infer = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Average OTC effect over the four intensities within each year
ct_avg <- contrast(emm_h, list("OTC avg vs Control" = c(-1, 1/4, 1/4, 1/4, 1/4)))
summary(ct_avg, type = "response", infer = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Dose response among the four OTC intensities within each year
emm_otc <- emmeans(h2_final, ~ heat_group | year,
                   at = list(heat_group = c("D", "C", "B", "A")))
contrast(emm_otc, "poly")
```


```{r}
# Multiplicative change in healthy weight per additional heat pulse
slope <- contrast(emm_otc, list("per extra pulse" = c(-3, -1, 1, 3) / 10))
summary(slope, type = "response", infer = TRUE)

# Difference in the dose-response slope between years (exploratory)
pairs(slope, by = NULL)
```


```{r}
# Average OTC effect over both years
emm_all <- emmeans(h2_final, ~ heat_group)
summary(contrast(emm_all, list("OTC avg vs Control" = c(-1, 1/4, 1/4, 1/4, 1/4))),
        type = "response", infer = TRUE)
```



```{r}
# Part 11: model estimates
emm_cell <- emmeans(h2_final, ~ heat_group | year * cultivar)
est <- as.data.frame(summary(emm_cell, type = "response"))   # response, lower.CL, upper.CL in grams

ggplot() +
  geom_jitter(data = d, aes(x = heat_group, y = healthy_weight),
              width = 0.12, colour = "grey60", alpha = 0.7, size = 1.6) +
  geom_errorbar(data = est, aes(x = heat_group, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                width = 0.15, colour = "grey35") +
  geom_line(data = est, aes(x = heat_group, y = response, group = 1),
            colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = est, aes(x = heat_group, y = response),
             colour = "steelblue", size = 2.4) +
  facet_grid(cultivar ~ year) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(Control = "Control", D = "D (1)", C = "C (2)",
                              B = "B (3)", A = "A (4)")) +
  labs(x = "Heat group (number of pulses)",
       y = "Healthy fruit weight (g)",
       title = "Estimated healthy fruit weight by heat group, cultivar and year",
       subtitle = "Blue = estimated means from the final model with 95% confidence intervals; grey = individual plots") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)
```




```{r}
# Part 12: Sensitivity to the most extreme plots
# Pearson residuals put Control and OTC plots on the same scale
d$r <- resid(h2_final, type = "pearson")
d %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(r))) %>%
  select(pair, year, cultivar, heat_group, healthy_weight, r) %>%
  head(6)

# The whole pairs of the 3 largest residuals are removed and the model is refitted
out_pairs <- d %>% arrange(desc(abs(r))) %>% slice(1:3) %>%
  pull(pair) %>% as.character() %>% unique()
d_sub <- d %>% filter(!pair %in% out_pairs) %>% droplevels()

h2_sub <- update(h2_final, data = d_sub)

emm_sub <- emmeans(h2_sub, ~ heat_group | year)
summary(contrast(emm_sub, "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "Control"), type = "response", infer = TRUE)
summary(contrast(emm_sub, list("OTC avg vs Control" = c(-1, 1/4, 1/4, 1/4, 1/4))),
        type = "response", infer = TRUE)

emm_sub_otc <- emmeans(h2_sub, ~ heat_group | year,
                       at = list(heat_group = c("D", "C", "B", "A")))
summary(contrast(emm_sub_otc, list("per extra pulse" = c(-3, -1, 1, 3) / 10)),
        type = "response", infer = TRUE)
```
